title: 6G-SDI — 4320-line and 2160-line Source Image and Ancillary Data Mapping for Quad-link 6G-SDI
scope: This standard defines the mapping of: • MODE 1: 4320-line Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) and High Dynamic Range (HDR) Y′C′BC′R 4:2:2 and 4:2:0 10-bit image formats and ancillary data into a Quad-link 6G-SDI 10-bit interface as defined in section 7 Quad-link 6G-SDI 10-bit Multiplex • MODE 2: 2160-line Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) and High Dynamic Range (HDR) R′G′B′, Y′C′BC′R 4:4:4(:4) 10-bit and 4:4:4 12-bit image formats and ancillary data into a Quad-link 6G-SDI 10-bit interface as defined in section 7 Quad-link 6G-SDI 10-bit Multiplex • MODE 3: 2160-line Standard Dynamic Range (SDR) and High Dynamic Range (HDR) Y′C′BC′R 4:2:2 and 4:2:0 10-bit High Frame Rate (HFR) Source image formats and ancillary data into a Quad-link 6GSDI 10-bit interface as defined in section 7 Quad-link 6G-SDI 10-bit Multiplex This Standard also defines the carriage of the SMPTE ST 352 payload ID’s for the Quad-link 6Gb/s SDI interface. It is not necessary for implementations to include support for all formats that are included in this Standard. Implementers are encouraged to indicate supported formats in commercial publications.
